title: Customer uncertainty about controls and purchase confidence
summary: This topic is dominated by undetermined comments about customers being unsure how to use specific features, with isolated positive and negative statements about overall ownership or purchase confidence.

positive.summary: One positive review says the customer was initially unsure but implies eventual satisfaction without naming a specific feature.

negative.summary: One negative review expresses hesitation about buying another BMW because of a prior bad ownership experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly describe uncertainty about operating features such as the radio, odometer, engine-running behavior, backup assistant, mirror, rear defroster, or recalling delivery instructions, and examples are insufficient to unify them into one narrower issue.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the topic has limited clear sentiment evidence.
The cluster mixes feature-operation questions, dealer uncertainty, delivery-orientation overload, and broader purchase hesitation rather than one single coherent issue.
Examples are too sparse to determine whether the uncertainty reflects usability problems, lack of training, or isolated customer confusion.
